verdict.rationale: The GitHub README shows `temporal server start-dev`, and the docs say the CLI includes a local development service that starts a complete Temporal Service with Web UI on your machine. The TypeScript testing-suite docs describe a test server that supports skipping time for end-to-end and integration tests with Workers. missing for 10: explicit evidence of mocking Activities/steps in workflow unit tests, independent or hands-on corroboration of the local dev server and testing utilities.
